tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ mtshan tsam yid la 'char bas kyang*// lha min mngal rnams lhung byed na// bskyed dang bzlas pas bdud sde'i dpung*// rmang med brlag byair gang de rgyal/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i dgongs gter rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi yum bka'i gsang sgrub seg ge'i gdong can gyi gtor bzlog thun mong ma yin pa gzhung ltar la/ thun mong pa ni gong gzhi rtsa gsum dang*/ gtor bzlog 'khor drug mtheb skyu ci mang gis bskor ba drag rgyan can mchod rdzas dang bcas bshams/ dngos gzhi ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog sngon du song nas/ hrīḥ sngon= sku gsum gsol 'debs sogs dang*/ brgyud 'debs/ chos dbyings spros pa= sogs dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i= hoḥ yid chos= lan gsum dang*/ rigs 'dus yan bdun/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ dkar bgegs dang*/ hūm̐ḥ bgegs zhes bya ba= nas shar 'don/ bstod pa mthar/ thugs kar nyi gdan= bsnyen sngags stong*/ sgrub sngags stong*/ a ka= stong*/ 'od zer= gong gi mchod bstod yig brgya/ gtor bzlog las/ swa bhā wa= mdun rten niḥ las byang las/ hūm̐ḥ rnal 'byor yongs= sogs sbyar/ dbyings su yalaḥ a ka 'i gsham du/ nṛ tri= sbyar ba stong*/ srung bzlog gi bdag nyid mkha' 'gro ma= srung sngags btags pa lnga brgya/ hūm̐ḥ rten dang= 'gugs pa tshar gsum gang skabs dang*/ spyi rgyug 'gugs pa tshig lhug ma gsum/ hūm̐ḥ snying rjes= lo tri'i sngags sbyar/ zhal bstab bcas/ bzlog pa/ hūm̐ḥ zhi ba= byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dus la babaḥ 'di yan tshar dgu/ hūm̐ḥ bsrung 'khor= bzlog gsham can stong*/ sangs rgyas= 'grub gyur cig: thal rdeb gsum/ hūm̐ḥ rnam pa nyi shus= dgra la bsgyuraḥ thun gtor 'phang*/ ma mgon tshe ring sogs gsol ka rgyas pa bya/ tshogs/ hoḥ bde ba= hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= mthar skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ mdor na mgor tshogs grangs bsag mdor na rab 'byams=

tshogs drang ba/ bsam lhun/ lhag ma/ bskul pa/ gtor 'gugs/ chos srung gtor 'bul/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ brtan bzhugs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas/ bzang spyod smon lam 'daun/ grol nyin/ lhag ma'i rjes su khang steng nas gser skyems/ hūm̐ḥ dbang po rdo= nang du bskul pa/ chad tho/ 'phen sar sleb nas rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud lta bu'i gser skyems/ 'gugs pa tshar gcig hūm̐ḥ rnam pa nyi shus= zor 'phang*/ brtan ma skyong*/ hūm̐ḥ sems las sems byung= gis srung 'khor bsgom/ sgo drung du 'gugs pa bcas rta bro/ nang du log nas rig 'dus lta bu'i tshe 'gugs/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ hoḥ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i= dngos grub blang*/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ shis brjod/ bzang spyod bcas kyis legs par grub bo// rdo rje me yi thog char 'dis// ma rung bdud sde'i klad 'gems nas// sde bzhi'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa yi// bstan dang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas shog /zhes pa'ang bla ma a lod kyi bzhed skong du pad+ma nor bus bris// dge'o//
